74-07-01A.ko:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS (비행계획 제한)
제한 없음.
FLIGHT CREW (운항승무원 조치)
AFTER ENGINE START (엔진 시동 후)
• 엔진 1이 해당되는 경우:
‐ ENGINE/1 AND 2/IGN/SYS A (49VU A03) C/B ..... PULL (C/B를 뽑는다)
‐ ENGINE/IGN/ENG 1/ SYS A BAT (121VU P39) C/B ..... PULL
‐ ENGINE/IGN/ENG 1/ SYS B (121VU P41) C/B ..... PULL
• 엔진 2가 해당되는 경우:
‐ ENGINE/1 AND 2/IGN/SYS A (49VU A03) C/B ..... PULL
‐ ENGINE/IGN/ENG 2/ SYS A BAT (121VU P40) C/B ..... PULL
‐ ENGINE/IGN/ENG 2/ SYS B (121VU P42) C/B ..... PULL
EWD에 ENG 1(2) A+B IGN FAULT alert가 표시되는지 확인한다.
• 엔진 1이 해당되는 경우:
‐ ENGINE/1 AND 2/IGN/SYS A (49VU A03) C/B ..... PUSH (C/B를 다시 밀어 넣는다)
‐ ENGINE/IGN/ENG 1/ SYS A BAT (121VU P39) C/B ..... PUSH
‐ ENGINE/IGN/ENG 1/ SYS B (121VU P41) C/B ..... PUSH
• 엔진 2가 해당되는 경우:
‐ ENGINE/1 AND 2/IGN/SYS A (49VU A03) C/B ..... PUSH
‐ ENGINE/IGN/ENG 2/ SYS A BAT (121VU P40) C/B ..... PUSH
‐ ENGINE/IGN/ENG 2/ SYS B (121VU P42) C/B ..... PUSH

74-31-01A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
     EDTO is not conducted.
  FLIGHT CREW
     Contact dispatcher for flight release update and “FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS”
     confirmation.
  BEFORE ENGINE START
     On ground, if the FADEC selects the Ignition System A during an automatic start, the engine fails
     to start and the alert related to the failure of the Ignition System A appears on the EWD. Then,
     the FADEC automatically initiates an additional engine start attempt with both ignition systems
     selected.
     To maximize the probability to start the engine at the first attempt, the Ignition System B must be
     selected by the FADEC. Perform one of the following engine starts:






      An automatic engine start:
        Before engine start:
          ENGINE/1 AND 2/IGN/SYS A (49VU A03) C/B .......................................................... PULL
           After engine start:
            ENGINE/1 AND 2/IGN/SYS A (49VU A03) C/B ......................................................... PUSH
      A manual engine start:
          Refer to FCOM/PRO-NOR-SUP-ENG Manual Engine Start - Procedure.
     It remains possible to perform an automatic engine start without pulling the circuit breakers of the
     Ignition System A. The first start attempt may be successful because the FADEC may select the
     Ignition System B. However, the first start attempt may fail because the FADEC may select the
     Ignition System A.
74-31-01A.ko:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS (비행계획 제한)
EDTO를 수행하지 않는다.
FLIGHT CREW (운항승무원 조치)
운항관리사(dispatcher)에게 연락하여 flight release 갱신과 “FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS” 확인을 받는다.
BEFORE ENGINE START (엔진 시동 전)
지상에서 자동 시동(automatic start) 중 FADEC이 Ignition System A를 선택하면 엔진 시동에 실패하고, Ignition System A 고장 관련 alert가 EWD에 나타난다. 그 다음 FADEC은 두 점화 계통을 모두 선택한 상태로 자동으로 추가 시동을 시도한다.
첫 시도에서 엔진이 시동될 확률을 최대로 하려면 FADEC이 Ignition System B를 선택하도록 해야 한다. 다음 중 한 가지 방법으로 엔진을 시동한다:
• 자동 시동(automatic engine start):
• 엔진 시동 전:
ENGINE/1 AND 2/IGN/SYS A (49VU A03) C/B ..... PULL (C/B를 뽑는다)
• 엔진 시동 후:
ENGINE/1 AND 2/IGN/SYS A (49VU A03) C/B ..... PUSH (C/B를 다시 밀어 넣는다)
• 수동 시동(manual engine start):
FCOM/PRO-NOR-SUP-ENG Manual Engine Start - Procedure 참조.
Ignition System A의 circuit breaker를 뽑지 않고 자동 시동을 하는 것도 여전히 가능하다. FADEC이 Ignition System B를 선택할 수 있으므로 첫 시동 시도가 성공할 수도 있다. 그러나 FADEC이 Ignition System A를 선택할 수 있으므로 첫 시동 시도가 실패할 수도 있다.

74-31-02A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
     No restrictions.





 FLIGHT CREW

 BEFORE ENGINE START
   On ground, if the FADEC selects the Ignition System B during an automatic start, the engine fails
   to start and the alert related to the failure of the Ignition System B appears on the EWD. Then,
   the FADEC automatically initiates an additional engine start attempt with both ignition systems
   selected.
   To maximize the probability to start the engine at the first attempt, the Ignition System A must be
   selected by the FADEC. Perform one of the following engine starts:
    An automatic engine start:
        Before engine start:
           ENGINE/IGN/ENG 1(2)/SYS B (121VU P41 or P42) C/B ........................................... PULL
        After engine start:
         ENGINE/IGN/ENG 1(2)/SYS B (121VU P41 or P42) C/B .......................................... PUSH
    A manual engine start:
       Refer to FCOM/PRO-NOR-SUP-ENG Manual Engine Start - Procedure.
   It remains possible to perform an automatic engine start without pulling the circuit breakers of the
   Ignition System B. The first start attempt may be successful because the FADEC may select the
   Ignition System A. However, the first start attempt may fail because the FADEC may select the
   Ignition System B.
